text: あの　あきちは　せんぞだいだい　わしの　いえの　とち　じゃった　のに！

structure.jp: せんぞだいだい　わしの　いえの　とち　じゃった　のに！
structure.en: was my family's land for generations, and yet!

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ in games and comics, so じゃった is だった. じゃった = 'was'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end means 'even though', with a feeling of bitterness that things turned out otherwise. じゃった　のに = 'it was, and yet'.
